title: The coach designs a plan, recorded
desc: A recorded Claude Code session with a made-up athlete: /fitness-coach plan asks its open questions first (a movement finding, which priorities come first, the start date, what could derail it), then designs three candidate plans, checks each with the engine and writes the pick through plan-write on a yes.
window: Claude Code · a demo vault, a made-up athlete

say: Step A is your questions, and I can't start designing until you answer. …
**1. Overhead reach (a self-check result you haven't confirmed).** … **Does pressing overhead hurt, or make your lower back arch? Yes or no.**
**2. Priority muscles: three named, room for two.** … **Which two come first this phase?** …
**4. Pre-mortem: picture week 6, this plan has failed. Why?** …

steps.user: 1: yes, it makes my lower back arch. 2: upper back and quads now, shoulders in phase 2. 3: Mon 9 Nov; yes, Tue, Thu and Sat. 4: the holidays in late December, and a packed gym on Monday evenings.

say: Candidate · Hard errors · What it costs · Minutes
**C1, heavy/light full body (the pick)** · 0 · Biceps at 3.5 sets while the ladder counts as a dead hang (see 7); obliques overridden · 50 / 43 / 46
C2, upper/lower/full · 0 · 9 shoulder sets in one session (over about 8); calves at 3; the lower day has no pulling · 42 / 46 / 42
C3, specialization block · 0 · Upper back at 21 sets, over the cap of 20; pull to push 4 to 1; triceps and abs under the minimum · 49 / 41 / 38
Overhead reach arches your back (yes) · No overhead pressing. Incline dumbbell and landmine pressing instead; upper-back and lat stretches in the warm-up
Every exercise's note ends with its "Why:" line, and `check` finds none missing.
**Write it as proposed?** Yes, or tell me what to change, …

steps.user: Yes, go with it as it is.

say: Your plan is written and starts **Monday 9 November**. Week 1 finds your working weights, so your first session is Tue 10 Nov.
The check on the plan as written (`engine check`) found no hard errors and no warnings. The biceps warning cleared once your pull-up level 6 was logged: …
